bio.text: Stephanie Nguyen was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 10th Assembly District and was re-elected in November 2024.
She was elected to the Elk Grove City Council in 2017 and previously served as Executive Director of Asian Resources, Inc.
Nguyen grew up in Sacramento's Little Saigon district, the daughter of Vietnamese refugees, and graduated from California State University, Sacramento.
